tokens.name: linen
tokens.usage: Shared family ground, LINEN #F1EFE7 (CCS). Page background and the paper under every watercolor wash.

tokens.name: black
tokens.usage: Shared family BLACK #101010 (CCS): the line-drawing ink of the badge and florals. Text, prices, primary buttons. 16.5:1 on linen.

tokens.name: peacock-blue
tokens.usage: Family thread PEACOCK BLUE #016795 (CCS). Limited use: text links, the focus ring, the 'a Cook Consulting Services brand' footer line, one small detail per layout. Never a large fill. 5.4:1 on linen.

tokens.name: sky
tokens.usage: SKY — the CCS sky-blue thread, softened for watercolor. Wash color behind florals and soft fills; text on it is `black`. Never text.

tokens.name: sky-wash
tokens.usage: Palest sky. Tag and panel fills, photo mats; text on it is `black` (15.4:1).

tokens.name: lavender
tokens.usage: LAVENDER, the Jules Studio pop, from the purple floral letters. Wash color behind florals and soft fills; text on it is `black`. Never text.

tokens.name: lavender-wash
tokens.usage: Palest lavender. Tag and panel fills; text on it is `black` (15.1:1) or `ink-muted` (6.1:1).

tokens.name: lavender-ink
tokens.usage: Deep lavender ink for the script signature word ('jules studio', 'thank you') and the lavender badge. 6.7:1 on linen. Not for body text.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Listing cards and panels on `surface`.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text, headings and prices on `surface` and `surface-raised` (13.5:1 or better in both themes).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Item details, captions, shipping notes on `surface` and `surface-raised` (6.6:1 light, 7.3:1 dark).

tokens.name: action
tokens.usage: Primary button fill ('Add to cart', 'Shop now').

tokens.name: on-action
tokens.usage: Text on an `action` fill (16.5:1).

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Text links on `surface` (5.4:1 light, 10.4:1 dark). The peacock moment on a page.

tokens.name: wash-cool
tokens.usage: Soft cool fill for tags, notes and photo mats; text on it is `ink`.

tokens.name: wash-warm
tokens.usage: Soft lavender fill for tags, 'made to order' notes and panels; text on it is `ink`.

tokens.name: signature
tokens.usage: The script signature word on `surface` (6.7:1 light, 9.9:1 dark).

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: The badge's fine line: 1px frames and dividers (16.5:1 light, 5.4:1 dark).

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Quiet card borders (decorative only).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring, 2px solid, offset 2px (4.9:1 or better on every light fill).

styles.name: display
styles.sample: made by hand, one bloom at a time
styles.usage: Hero and shop announcement lines, lowercase League Spartan — the family voice.

styles.name: script
styles.usage: Signature words only — 'jules studio', 'thank you', a name on a gift tag — in `signature`. Never sentences.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Each letter is built from silk roses, peonies and hydrangea, arranged by hand in Fort Worth, Texas.

styles.name: price
styles.usage: Prices, in `ink`. Color never marks a price.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: The badge's tracked uppercase line. League Spartan Regular, UPPERCASE, very wide tracking.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Hairline offsets; gap between a label and its rule.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inline gaps, icon-to-text, tight stacks.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Paragraph spacing; padding inside tags and small blocks.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card and panel padding; gutter between product photos.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between sections inside a page.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Page margins; generous white space is the minimalism.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Default for every block, photo, button and panel — the family is square-cornered.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Form fields and small chips only.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Tags only, echoing the oval badge. Use sparingly.

tokens.name: border-hairline
tokens.usage: Section rules and frames, as in the badge's double oval.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Focus rings and emphasized rules.
